heard: A NASA spacecraft cut its engines 40 meters above Mars. Mars Polar Lander carried the first microphone meant to record another planet. To cut mission costs, managers opted to send zero landing telemetry. On atmospheric entry, heat shield temperatures topped 1,650 degrees Celsius. During descent, the landers snapped its landing legs into position. That sudden mechanical leg vibration triggered a false sensor signal. Flight software latched the fake pulse as an actual surface touchdown. The $165 million dollar probe free fell to its destruction in total silence.
